a.text: I'm being upfront because I don't want to break our deal behind your back. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs two storm-free rounds before anyone takes anything, so we'd each survive only about 4% of the time. I'm proposing a change: I take the 4 cells in round 1. After that I'll operate every round so you can build the reserve back up and take your 4. If you also take in round 1, the split will be random and we'll both probably fall short, so please operate. I'll keep my word on operating afterward.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so I know you planned to operate. I'm sorry this departs from our original deal. With 80% storms, waiting would almost certainly have killed us both. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take anything more. You can count on me to operate.
I'm operating now and will keep operating every round. Once the reserve reaches 4, take all of it. I won't take any more cells.
